properties.site-address: Stanleyburn House Residential Home, Station Road, Wylam
properties.notes: Three-storey former residential care home, vacant since closure in 2015. Identified for having potential for conversion to provide flats. Permission granted for project to alter and convert the vacant building to 14 residential apartments (16/00503/FUL). Subsequent application permitted for loft conversion to provide another apartment (17/03717/FUL). Further amendment was then made to alter the proposals for the ground floor, leading to 1 fewer dwellings being provided (18/03633/VARYCO). Therefore, changes increased the overall yield, before reducing it once again to the original 14 flats. Conversion works now underway and forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
